questions: Table S1 lists four moiré devices and Section F shows high-field supercurrent in GH1 and GH2. How many junctions did you fabricate and cool down in total, and does "reproduced across multiple additional devices" (p. 3) refer to GH2 alone for the high-field result?
Section F sets GH3 and GH4 aside for their length. Were other junctions on the same mesas measured (Fig. S1a shows several contacts), and how did they behave at high field?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown, in particular the hole minibands (n/ns < -1) at high field and fields between 6 T and the 8 T magnet limit?
What does the second-best high-field interference pattern look like, and how were n/ns ∼ 1.8 and B ∼ 4.3 T chosen for Fig. 2c?
How was the 3447 Ω series resistance calibrated, and could you show the raw two-terminal dV/dI for Fig. 2b and the 1/R map of Fig. 3e before subtraction?
How does the correlation between 1/R and <v^2>/vF^2 in Fig. 3c-e look when you use the 200 nA map of Fig. S14 or a field map at 10 K, where superconductivity is suppressed?
Can you extract a current distribution, or test for SQUID-like lobes, from the high-field patterns in Fig. 2c and Fig. S11, as you did at zero field in Fig. S9?
How often did the field-cycling procedure of SI Sec. A.2 fail to give a reproducible pattern, and could you share the raw data and the analysis code for the Ic extraction and the <v^2> maps?
